tough.h2: Built for a dog that never clocks out
tough.html:
A German shepherd doesn't wear a tag. It takes the tag on patrol: fence-line sprints, pool laps in July, wrestling matches with the other dog, and a lot of scratching at a collar buried under a coat that never actually stops shedding.

Ours are laser engraved, so the words are cut into the metal instead of painted on top. On colored tags the laser lifts the anodized color and exposes bright silver underneath; on stainless and brass the mark goes dark. Mud, pool water and a full shedding season can't peel off something that isn't stuck on.

The joke outlasts the undercoat. Which is saying something.

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. The shepherd jokes come from the shepherds we meet at the dog park, every one of them staring at our bulldogs like they forgot to file a report.

items.q: Will shedding, swimming and mud wear off the engraving?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's no ink to rub, wash or sweat off. Fur, pool water and mud don't erase an engraving.

items.q: Can I put my shepherd's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name plus your phone number are engraved on the back. A third back line is optional.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for German shepherds?
items.a: Eight on this page, about the ears, the shedding, the herding and the running commentary. Every one fits the tag as written, and the full sayings list has hundreds more.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: Custom tags aren't returnable, but if we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Send a photo and we re-cut it. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
